what: Classes (see TIMETABLE), except on arrival and orientation days, exam Fridays and the festival days marked "No classes". The clock tower bell marks every slot.
The weekly stipend is paid; new slips go up on the job board.

Chuck's open storytelling hour in his workshop, if the half-door is open. Student council session in the council chamber, open to any student: octavia in the chair, sebastian (vice-president; permits and sanctions), imara (treasurer; job-board pay and club money are counted out at her table afterwards), tavita (head proctor), pilar (events and press), noor clerking, teobalt as first-year delegate.
Judge Circle in Seminar Room 2B (noor, hana; from Day 67 moved to Monday Afternoon).
'The Top Deck' goes live from the broadcast studio (bex; from Day 67 late Afternoon).
Ferry day: the Second Chance arrives at the Academy dock about mid-morning and leaves again at Midday; mail, parcels, visitors, the visiting doctor (Wednesdays).
Swim squad at the pool (sunny). Wednesday, Night: astronomy club at the old observatory on clear nights (until Day 67).

Student council session (the same seven as on Monday; Thursday is petitions and rulings: tavita reads the inspection and slip list aloud, sebastian gives his rulings on permits and ladder penalties, pilar takes the minute for the bulletin); theatre rehearsal (marit). Every other Thursday, Evening: movie night in the student lounge.
Friday Night Draft at the Sleeve & Binder (dex, mika). Friday, Evening/Night: bonfire at the Commons pit (until Day 67 freely, afterwards with permission and only until the end of the Evening slot).
Market stalls on Main Street. Town day for most of the school.
Saturday Sanctioned at the Sleeve & Binder: a small sanctioned event, eight players, single elimination, mika judging (a win here counts as a sanctioned event win).

when: Every second Saturday, Evening and Night
what: The Night Market in Port Mulligan (Days 6, 20, 34, 48, 62, 76, 90, 104, 111, 125, 139, 153, 167, 181, 195, 209); Madame Oru's tent at the far end.
Quiet day: Silas winds the tower clock in the Morning; beach, laundry, letters home; the library is full by Evening.
Battle Team conditioning in the gym (rox, lilia, willas, dom, saoirse — sometimes, kenji, priya).
